meta.description: Authored, not auto-activated. Pure-HTTP, self-priming ROVER incremental crawl (no browser, no manual secureConfig). Validated against live data 2026-06. Discovery primes the session + extracts Base64SecureConfiguration from the directory page, pages the grid (DESC by last-updated) to the high-water mark with a per-run cap, filters to towing-relevant categories; Process fetches each VTADetails page (throttled, jittered 4–10s, sequential, oldest-first) and POSTs the HTML to /api/rover/ingest, advancing the high-water mark only on success; a circuit-breaker aborts on 403/429/503; crawl-health alerts on a silent 0-found. Set ROVER_INGEST_TOKEN (and optionally APP_BASE_URL) on the n8n host. See ops/n8n/README.md.
